page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-384-standardlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 384 dedicated virtual CPUs. The system is equipped with 3024.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 7.88 GB of memory per core. This configuration delivers a high density of both compute and memory resources on a single instance.

A primary feature of this server type is its integrated local storage capacity. It includes 90194 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 24 local SSD drives. This bundled storage configuration is designed for high-throughput and low-latency data access directly on the physical host. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or hardware GPU accelerators.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the z4d-highmem-384-standardlssd consolidates massive memory arrays and extensive local NVMe storage into a single high-density node, reducing the need for distributed storage clustering. This hardware profile is engineered for demanding workloads such as large-scale relational databases, in-memory data stores, extensive data warehousing, and high-performance transaction processing systems that require immediate access to massive local datasets.
